text: ばしょに　よって　よく　でる　スロットが　あるようね

structure.jp: よく　でる　スロットが
structure.en: slot machines that pay out often

patterns.name: 〜によって
patterns.explanation: によって after a thing says the result changes from one to another of that thing. ばしょに　よって = 'depending on the spot'.

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.explanation: よう after a verb says 'it seems', a guess from what the speaker has seen; だ is dropped before ね in soft speech. あるようね = 'there seem to be, don't there'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: よく　でる　スロット
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, placed right before a thing, tells you which thing. よく　でる　スロット = 'slot machines that pay out often'.
